intro: Financial services, government, and healthcare organisations globally, with a particular focus in the United Kingdom, are the primary targets in our patch-management coverage from 12 April to 3 May 2026. Seven articles examine a severity mix of four medium, two high, and one critical vulnerability, including CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. Small businesses are also among the affected sectors.
